sources.title: lama: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview lama is a resolution-robust image inpainting model developed by twn39 that fills in masked regions of images using Fourier Convolutions. The model takes an input image and a mask (white regions indicate areas to inpaint) and returns a completed image with the masked regions filled in. This is the WACV 2022 paper implementation, built on the LaMa (Large Mask Inpainting) architecture ...

sources.snippet: Roman et al. introduced LaMa [arXiv] (Large Mask Inpainting) model in 2021. It showed great result in image inpainting, by using Fourier convolutions. This innovative method of Fourier convolution was introdced in NeurIPS 2020 [nips] . It allows model to work on frequency domain so that we can have large receptive fields. sources.snippet: LaMa is a feed-forward model (single pass, deterministic). Diffusion-based inpainting (flux kontext, Step1X Edit) is iterative (20-50 steps) but better at semantic content (faces, complex objects).
